notes.title: Updates this week.
notes.content:
Greetings survivors, 
We have done the update and thank you for your continued support. 
[Update Content]
1. Friday event resources update
2. Added a new Guardian Attack hero - Nova
3. Added a limited skin of Nova - Bunny Mao
4. Now the gene enhanced Lv2 and Lv3 heroes can be rolled back in Transplant Center
5. The numbers of Star Soul in the Star Soul packs have been increased, and the purchase limit of the Star Soul packs will be reset after the update
6. The rewards of the Ancient Vault have been adjusted. After the update, the reward status of the Ancient Vault and the purchase limit of the packs will be reset.
7. After purchasing normal and mini monthly cards in the VIP privilege, you will get extra gold coins and elixirs rewards every day
8. You can now choose gold coin rewards from Lucky bag packs, and you can preview all rewards
9. Fix the bug that the sold out logo on Ancient Ruins store merchandises won't disappear before loggin again
10. Fixed the bug that the effect of the energy gaining of ultimate did not take effect after General Talos wore Greedy Chip set
11. Fixed the bug that Kerbero did not turn into a tomb after death in some cases
If you have any suggestions or bug feedback, please feel free to send us a private message✉️ or write in the comment section!
